message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round and by collecting cards from opponents. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two Draw Two, two Reverse, two Skip). 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile. Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If the first card is a special card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top card on the discard pile. You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four card at any time. | | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Uno Call** | When you have only one card left, you must say “UNO” before your opponent takes their turn. If you fail to call UNO and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can stack further. | | **No Wild Draw Four** | Remove Wild Draw Four cards for a simpler game. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack) that add new mechanics. | **Quick Tips** 1. Keep track of the current color and number to anticipate opponents’ moves. 2. Save your Wild cards for when you’re stuck or to change the color to your advantage. 3. Pay attention to the “UNO” rule—missing it can cost you extra cards. Enjoy playing Uno!
